claims_supported: Circle Investor Relations lists separate Q3 2026 earnings press-release and earnings-presentation PDF links.
Circle's Q3 2026 earnings release date is November 4, 2026.

Total revenue and reserve income was $864.888 million; reserve income was $657.624 million; other revenue was $207.264 million, including $182 million from the ARC token presale.

Circle Payments Network annualized TPV was $41.3 billion.
Circle disclosed a $100 million Binance equity investment announcement and a five-year USDC partnership expansion.
